name: Infraud Organization
description: The Infraud Organization was a massive international cybercrime forum founded in 2010 that facilitated the large-scale purchase, sale, and dissemination of stolen financial and personal identity data. With over 10,000 members, it caused more than $530 million in actual losses. In February 2018, US authorities charged 36 members in 17 countries, arrested 13, in one of the largest coordinated law enforcement actions against cybercrime.

sources.title: U.S. Arrests 13, Charges 36 in 'Infraud' Cybercrime Forum Bust — Krebs on Security
